name: Trinidad and Tobago
description: Trinidad and Tobago from its first peoples to Spanish, French and British rule, Indian labourers, independence in 1962, oil, calypso and carnival.

checkpoints.name: Spanish, French and British
checkpoints.note: Columbus came in 1498. Spain invited French planters, and Britain took Trinidad in 1797. Indian labourers came after slavery.

checkpoints.name: Independent
checkpoints.note: Trinidad and Tobago became independent in 1962. Oil and gas made it rich, and carnival made it famous.
